name: Increased Devotion
body:
Your animal companion’s increased devotion to you gives it even greater resistance to unwanted mental control.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Animal Companion, ranger level 6.

Benefit(s): Your animal companion’s Devotion bonus is equal to 4 + ½ your ranger level.

Normal: An animal companion’s Devotion bonus is +4.
